ὦτόν: Ὦτος — Otus, brother of Ephialtes; masc. acc. sg.

__broaden__.ἤλυθον: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 1 sg., augmented, epic root ἐλυθ- with epenthetic -υ- (= Attic ἦλθον): ’I have come’ · also aor. 3 pl. (the form serves both persons): ’they came’
__broaden__.ἔχευεν: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg., in tmesis with ἐν (ἐν … ἔχευεν = ἐνέχευεν): ’poured in’ · also in tmesis with κατά (κατὰ … ἔχευεν = κατέχευεν): ’poured down, shed’
__broaden__.θεὸς: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’as a god’ · also plain nom. sg. subject, an unspecified deity left unnamed: ’a god’ (θεὸς δ’ ἐκέδασσεν Ἀχαιούς ’a god scattered the Achaeans’) · also of a goddess (θεός is common gender) · also nom. sg. subject, of a god already introduced by epithets but not yet named: ’the god’
__broaden__.τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. dual: ’the two of them’  ·  also acc. dual, object of a verb of address: τὼ … προσέφη ’spoke to the two of them’ · also relative, nom. dual, ’who (the two)’: τοκῆε δύω, τὼ μὴ γείνασθαι ὄφελλον · also nom. dual with a noun, article-like: ’the two’ (τὼ … θεράποντε)
__broaden__.ἀμφοτέρω: ἀμφότερος — both; masc. nom. dual, doubling the dual pronoun for emphasis: ’both of us’ · also masc. nom. dual in apposition to a dual noun: ’both’ (τὼ … θεράποντε … ἀμφοτέρω) · also acc. dual, object: ’both of them’
__broaden__.εὔχετ: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; impf. 3 sg., elided (εὔχετ’ = εὔχετο), + dat.: ’prayed to’ · also + inf., ’boast, claim’ (εὔχετ’ … ἰαῦσαι ’claimed to have lain’)
__broaden__.παῖδ: παῖς — child, daughter; fem. acc. sg., elided (παῖδ’ = παῖδα) · also masc. acc. sg. (παῖς is common gender; here of a son, Telemachus): ’son’ · also masc. acc. dual, elided (παῖδ’ = παῖδε), with δύο: ’two sons’
__broaden__.ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which; masc. dat. sg. (δοίη δ’ ᾧ κ’ ἐθέλοι ’give her to whom he wished’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg. (same form), agreeing with a neut. noun: πεδίοιο ... ᾧ ἔνι ... ’a plain in which is...’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἄχεϊ: ’her own (grief)’
__broaden__.σχομένη: ἔχω — have, hold; aor. mid. part. fem. nom. sg., here ’holding (before)’ · also ἔχομαι + dat., ’held fast by, seized with’ (ἄχεϊ σχομένη)
__broaden__.μὴ: μή — not; negative particle in wishes, prohibitions, and purpose/fear clauses · also negating a conditional clause after εἰ: εἰ μὴ ’if not, unless’ · also negating a generic relative clause with the opt.: ὃς μὴ … ἐλάσειε ’whoever did not drive off’
__broaden__.βίης: βίη — might, force; fem. gen. sg., gen. of separation with σχέσθαι ’hold back from force’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of μνησαμένοις: ’of the might’ (Κύκλωπός τε βίης ’the Cyclops’ might’) · also periphrastic gen. with a proper adj.: ’the force of Iphicles’ (βίης Ἰφικληείης, a periphrasis for his name)
__broaden__.εὖρος: Εὖρος — the East Wind, personified; masc. nom. sg. · also εὖρος — breadth, width; neut. acc. sg., of respect: ’in breadth’
__broaden__.ὄσσαν: ὄσσα — voice, rumour, report (personified, from Zeus); acc. sg. · also Ὄσσα — Ossa, a mountain in Thessaly; fem. acc. sg.: ’Mount Ossa’
__broaden__.εἰνοσίφυλλον: εἰνοσίφυλλος — leaf-shaking, with quivering foliage; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄρος · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with Πήλιον
__broaden__.ἐμή: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg. (= nom. in form), agreeing with μῆτερ: ’my (mother)’
__broaden__.κρατερὸν: κρατερός — strong, mighty (by-form of καρτερός); masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with μένος as subject
__broaden__.γύναι: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. voc. sg.: ’wife’ · also fem. voc. sg., plain address to a woman who is not a wife: ’woman’ (χαῖρε, γύναι ’be glad, woman’)
__broaden__.κάλλιπ: καταλείπω — leave behind; aor. imper. 2 sg., κατα- cut short and assimilated (κάλλιπ’ = κατάλιπε), elided · also aor. indic. 3 sg., unaugmented (κάλλιπ’ = κατέλιπε): ’she left behind’
__broaden__.κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ)
__broaden__.λεύκ: λευκός — white; neut. nom. pl., elided (λεύκ’ = λευκά) · also neut. acc. pl., elided (λεύκ’ = λευκά), agreeing with ὀστέα: ’white’
__broaden__.πρώτην: πρῶτος — first; fem. acc. sg., in ἐς πρώτην ’to the first (person)’ · also fem. acc. sg. agreeing with an understood object ’her’: πρώτην ἱκέτευσας ’you besought her first’ · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with a named object, ’first’ (πρώτην Τυρὼ ἴδον ’I saw Tyro first’)
__broaden__.χαῖρε: χαίρω — rejoice; pres. imper. 2 sg., the ordinary greeting: ’welcome, hail’ · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔχαιρε): ’he rejoiced’ (χαῖρε φήμῃ ’rejoiced at the omen-word’) · also the imperative at parting: ’farewell’ · also with a dative of cause, ’be glad’ (χαῖρε … φιλότητι ’be glad in love’)
